title: Abba ben Yose (a Tanna)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Sifrei, Naso 42, where Rabbi speaks in his name; but Hyman says the reading there should be Abba Yose.[^1]

notes.text: The complete actual Wikisource Sifrei Bamidbar 42 paragraph contains Rabbi speaking in the name of Abba ben Yose. It separately contains Abba Yose ben Dostai, which is not substituted into this notice. Hyman’s proposed Abba Yose reading remains his emendation, and the source’s unnamed Rabbi is not expanded into a personal identity.
